info.title: Care OAU API
info.description: API documentation for Care OAU system

post.description: Creates a new user account and sends an email verification code to activate the account.

message.example: Registration successful. Please verify your email address to activate your account.

409.description: An account with this email already exists

post.description: Verifies the user's email address using the verification code sent to their email and creates a session upon successful verification. The server returns a session cookie that the client must store and send with subsequent requests to maintain the authenticated session.
Authenticates a user using their email and password and creates a session.

403.description: Email address has not been verified

post.description: Requests a password reset email for the provided email address. Only verified accounts are eligible. The response does not reveal whether an account exists.

message.example: If your account exists, you'll receive a password reset email

post.description: Resets the user's password using a valid, unexpired password reset code.

message.example: Your password has been reset successfully

post.description: Logs out the currently authenticated user by revoking their active session and clearing the session cookie.

get.description: Fetches the profile of the currently authenticated user using their active session.
Retrieves open clinical services available to students, including the service name, description, and referral requirement.

services.name: Dental Care
services.description: Dental consultations, oral examinations, and routine dental care.

post.description: Creates a clinical service with its operating days, opening hours, daily capacity, and referral requirements. New services default to open status.

category.description: general_medicine: General consultations. dental: Dental care. optometry: Eye care. laboratory: Laboratory tests and investigations. mental_health: Mental health services. other: Other clinical services.

description.example: Outpatient consultations for general illnesses, infections, and routine diagnoses.

service.name: General Medical Consultation
service.description: Outpatient consultations for general illnesses, infections, and routine diagnoses.

400.description: The request body contains invalid service data

409.description: A service with the same name and category already exists

message.example: A service with this name and category already exists

get.description: Retrieves all clinical services, including open and closed services, with their operating days and hours.

services.name: General Medical Consultation
services.description: Outpatient consultations for general illnesses, infections, and routine diagnoses.

services.name: Dental Consultation
services.description: Dental examinations and oral healthcare services.

get.summary: Get a service by public ID
get.description: Retrieves a single clinical service using its public ID, including its operating days, hours, capacity, and referral requirements.

service.name: General Medical Consultation
service.description: Outpatient consultations for general illnesses, infections, and routine diagnoses.

404.description: The requested service was not found

patch.description: Updates the provided service fields. Schedule changes preserve existing operating days and hours where possible. Newly added operating days inherit existing hours unless new times are supplied.

400.description: The service has no operating days

message.example: A service must have at least one operating day

404.description: The requested service was not found

delete.description: Soft-deletes a clinical service. The service is excluded from normal service lookups while historical appointment records are preserved.

404.description: The requested service was not found or has already been deleted

patch.description: Opens or closes an existing clinical service without changing its other details.

service.name: General Medical Consultation
service.description: Outpatient consultations for general illnesses, infections, and routine diagnoses.

400.description: The service already has the requested status

404.description: The requested service was not found

post.description: Creates a doctor and their recurring work schedule. The selected clinical service is resolved using its public ID. A new doctor defaults to available status, and the doctor and schedule are created in a single database transaction.

service.description: The clinical service to which the doctor belongs. Use the service public ID, not its internal database ID.

400.description: The selected clinical service does not exist

409.description: A doctor with the same name already exists under the selected service

message.example: Doctor already exists under this service

get.description: Retrieves all doctors with their current status, associated clinical service, and recurring work schedule.

get.summary: Get a doctor by public ID
get.description: Retrieves one doctor using their public ID, including their clinical service and recurring work schedule.

404.description: The requested doctor was not found

patch.description: Updates the supplied doctor fields. Schedule changes must be provided inside the schedule object. The service is selected using its public ID. When changing only one schedule time, the new time is checked against the other saved time. End time must be later than start time.

service.description: The replacement clinical service, identified by public ID.

schedule.description: Optional schedule fields. Include only the fields to change. The final saved start and end times must form a valid time range.

consultingRoom.description: The consulting room can also be updated at the top level.

400.description: The resulting schedule has an invalid time range

message.example: End time must be later than start time

404.description: The requested doctor was not found

delete.description: Soft-deletes a doctor using their public ID. The doctor is marked as deleted and excluded from new bookings while their historical appointment records are preserved.

404.description: The requested doctor was not found or has already been deleted

patch.description: Updates a doctor's current attendance status without changing their name, title, clinical service, or schedule.

status.description: available: Ready to see patients. in_consultation: Currently consulting. on_break: Temporarily on a break. arriving_soon: Expected to arrive shortly. off_duty: Not currently on duty. on_leave: On leave.

404.description: The requested doctor was not found

get.description: Retrieves appointment slots for a selected clinical service on a specified date. The doctorPublicId query parameter is optional. When omitted, availability is returned for all doctors who provide the selected service. When supplied, availability is returned only for the selected doctor.

parameters.name: servicePublicId
parameters.description: Public ID of the clinical service.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date for which appointment availability is requested.

parameters.name: doctorPublicId
parameters.description: Optional public ID of a doctor. Omit this parameter to check availability across all eligible doctors for the selected service.

400.description: The selected doctor does not provide the selected service

message.example: Doctor does not provide this service

404.description: The selected doctor was not found

post.description: Books a 30-minute appointment for the authenticated student. The service and doctor are identified by their public IDs. The doctorPublicId is required. The appointment is created with pending status after the requested slot, doctor's schedule, working day, and daily patient limit are validated.

servicePublicId.description: Public ID of the clinical service.

doctorPublicId.description: Public ID of the selected doctor.

appointmentDate.description: Requested appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

startTime.description: Requested start time in 24-hour format. The appointment lasts 30 minutes.

400.description: The requested appointment time has already passed

message.example: Appointments must be booked for a future time

404.description: The selected doctor was not found

409.description: The requested appointment slot overlaps an existing appointment

message.example: This appointment slot is no longer available

get.description: Retrieves appointments belonging to the authenticated student, including status, clinical service, doctor, date, time, reason, and consulting room. Appointments are ordered from most recently created to oldest.

patch.description: Cancels an appointment belonging to the authenticated student. Only appointments with pending or approved status can be cancelled. The appointment's historical record is preserved.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public ID of the appointment to cancel.

400.description: The appointment cannot be cancelled in its current status

message.example: This appointment can no longer be cancelled

403.description: The appointment belongs to another student

message.example: You are not allowed to cancel this appointment

404.description: The requested appointment was not found

get.description: Retrieves appointments for the admin dashboard, including student details, clinical service, doctor, appointment date and time, consulting room, reason, and status. Results are ordered from most recently created to oldest. An optional status query parameter filters the results.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional appointment status filter. Omit it to retrieve appointments with all statuses.

400.description: An unsupported appointment status was provided

patch.description: Approves a pending appointment. Only appointments with pending status can be approved.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public ID of the appointment to approve.

400.description: The appointment cannot be approved in its current status

message.example: Only pending appointments can be approved

404.description: The requested appointment was not found

patch.description: Rejects a pending appointment by changing its status to rejected. Only appointments with pending status can be rejected. Rejected appointments do not consume doctor appointment capacity.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public ID of the appointment to reject.

400.description: The appointment cannot be rejected in its current status

message.example: Only pending appointments can be rejected

404.description: The requested appointment was not found

patch.description: Checks in a patient for an approved appointment by changing its status to checked_in. Only approved appointments can be checked in. This operation does not itself generate a queue ticket.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public ID of the appointment to check in.

400.description: The appointment is not approved and cannot be checked in

message.example: Only approved appointments can be checked in

404.description: The requested appointment was not found

patch.description: Marks an appointment as completed after the patient has checked in. Only appointments with checked_in status can be completed.

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: Public ID of the appointment to complete.

400.description: The appointment has not been checked in and cannot be completed

message.example: Only checked-in appointments can be completed

404.description: The requested appointment was not found
